item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena keeps a potted tulsi plant in her kitchen. She tells her brother that the plant respires all the time, even at night when there is no sunlight.

Which statement about respiration in the tulsi plant is correct?

options.A: Glucose reacts with oxygen in all parts of the plant, releasing carbon dioxide, water, and energy.
options.B: Glucose breaks down to release carbon dioxide, water, and energy even when no oxygen is available.
options.C: Only the green leaves of the plant carry out respiration; the roots and stem do not.
options.D: The plant takes in carbon dioxide and water to make glucose and release energy during respiration.
